text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Admin time dropped, but not where we expected.** Reps saved the most time on CRM updates after calls, roughly 4 hours a week each.

**2. Managers got better coaching material.** Searchable transcripts made it easy to spot which discovery questions actually moved deals forward.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated. Reps who explained the purpose upfront saw almost no pushback.

**4. In-person meetings were the gap.** Noisy sites and walk-and-talk visits hurt accuracy, so we added a quick voice recap habit.

**5. Adoption followed trust.** Usage climbed once reps saw summaries were editable, not final.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It gave reps more time to use it.

What would you want from an AI note-taker in the field?
